newsitem.title: USA: Coleman returning headquarters to Kansas.
newsitem.headline: Coleman returning headquarters to Kansas.

text.p: Coleman Company Inc., which makes camping stove and lanterns and other equipment, said Tuesday it is returning its corporate headquarters to Wichita, Kan., where the company was founded at the turn of the century.
Coleman had moved its corporate headquarters from Wichita to Golden, Colo., in 1995.

The City of Wichita, Sedgwick County and the State of Kansas are providing a combined total of $500,000 in economic development funding to assist Coleman in the relocation, according to a statement issued by the company and Wichita Mayor Bob Knight.

The Wichita City Council will also consider issuing industrial revenue bonds and accompanying tax abatements, as well as special assistance in helping Coleman executives and their families relocate, it said.

Coleman posted a $42 million net loss last year and in mid-April it announced a series of actions to improve profitability. These included closing and consolidating one international and three domestic factories and cutting its work force of 7,000 by about 10 percent.
At the time, the company also said it would close its corporate and regional headquarters in Golden and Geneva, Switzerland.
Shares of Coleman closed at 17, unchanged from its close May 23.
